title: Desktop context menu steals relative mouse position from widget config windows
line: With the desktop or widget context menu open, moving the pointer over a settings window no longer highlights or opens items in the menu.
explanation: While a popup is open, Qt forwards pointer events that reach any other window of the app to the popup, mapped by global position. On Wayland other toplevels' global positions are unknown, so an event in the Desktop Folder Settings window was mapped as if that window sat at the screen's top-left, and the desktop QMenu highlighted, opened submenus for and reacted to the item at the window-local position. The change installs a small event filter while the containment/applet context menu is open on Wayland: it tracks which window the pointer really is in (Enter/Leave), ignores pointer events reaching the menu while the pointer is in an unrelated window (not a popup and not the window that opened the menu), and closes the menu on a press there, letting the press reach that window.

commits.message:
containmentitem: keep other windows from driving the menu on Wayland

Qt forwards pointer events from other windows to the open menu by global
position, unknown on Wayland, so hovering a settings window highlighted
menu items; drop those events and let a press there close the menu.

BUG: 504809

media.caption: Master: desktop menu open at the top-left, pointer in the settings window's sidebar (520,481); the menu's Icons item is highlighted and its submenu opens
Fixed, same steps: the menu is untouched and the window's own sidebar gets the hover
Master: pointer at (520,515) in the window highlights the menu's Enter Edit Mode
Fixed: same pointer position, no menu item highlighted
Fixed: hovering the menu itself still highlights items and opens nested submenus (Icons > Icon Size); moving into the settings window afterwards leaves them alone
Fixed: clicking in the settings window closes the menu and the click reaches the window (Icons page opened)

review.text: The cause is in Qt (QWindowPrivate::forwardToPopup maps other windows' pointer events by global position, unknown on Wayland), and this is a ~60-line app-wide event filter in libplasma that works around it for two QMenus only; other Qt popups in plasmashell keep the bug. The filter looks correct and the media show the fix, but maintainers will want the Qt fix sent upstream first and the workaround tied to it.
changes: Submit the existing qtbase patch (fixdb-prev/504809/qtbase-fix.patch) to Qt Gerrit and file a QTBUG.
If the libplasma workaround is kept until a Qt release ships the fix, reference the QTBUG in the comment and guard/remove it by Qt version.
